crop.notes: The first item, 'Pugilistic--A Match Between McCoole and Gallagher', is about Allen. The rest of the clipping is an unrelated item on the will of Chas. Beardslee.

ocr.notes: The Allen item is partly garbled in the middle ('shangha; Tis breads'te chelloces Wine'); the will item is mostly readable.

title.suggested: McCoole and Allen Match Called Off After Gallagher Challenge

summary.suggested: The Daily Missouri Democrat reported that Mike McCoole and Tom Allen agreed at Alex. McKee's to withdraw their stakes and postpone their fight after Charley Gallagher sent word challenging McCoole.

metadata.notes: Masthead: 'Daily Democrat, Tuesday Morning, March 9, 1869'. The meeting was 'last night', March 8, 1869.

facts.fact: At a meeting at Alex. McKee's, McCoole and Allen agreed to withdraw the stakes on their match and postpone the fight
The reason given was a dispatch from Charley Gallagher, 'the Cleveland shanghai', authorizing his friends to challenge McCoole to a fight in about two months

notes: Allen's own card (article 313) gives a different account: McCoole refused to put up the $500 deposit at the Broad Gauge saloon on the 8th and demanded different stakes.
